tagline: Make risk scores reflect your business reality.
lore: Anubis, who weighs the heart against the feather of truth — here he weighs each asset's true criticality, so every priority built on it is honest.
problem: Out-of-the-box Asset Criticality Ratings rarely match reality: the test box scores like a crown jewel while the payment server sits at a default. Tenable One's exposure scores, and every hound that ranks by ACR, inherit that one wrong number.
does: Anubis changes the ACR of every asset that carries a tag — set it to a value, or raise or lower it by N — with a business reason Tenable records alongside it. It shows exactly what navi will change before anything is written, logs every change, and can protect the assets it changed from later overwrites.

glance.caption: Anubis's own At a glance: assets the Hounds changed and whether they are protected (NO : UPDATE), what navi will skip, and changes by business case — read from navi.db and the ACR log.

capabilities: pick any tag from the live Tenable tag list and calibrate every asset on it at once; ACR stays within 1–10.
Business Critical, In Scope For Compliance, Existing Mitigation Control or Dev Only, plus an optional note — sent to Tenable with the change.
per change: how many assets will change, how many are protected, how many have no ACR yet and will be skipped.
describe the calibration ("production to 9, lab down 2") and an optional AI model drafts the changes; only existing tags and scores 1–10 pass, and you approve each.
tag the assets the Hounds changed so later bulk changes leave them alone — navi skips any asset tagged exactly NO : UPDATE.
every change the Hounds made: asset, before and after, selector, business case — filterable and exportable.
how: The tag list comes live from `navi explore info tags`; preview and protection read your local navi.db. Changes run through `navi enrich acr` (set / inc / dec), behind the write gate and an explicit confirm. A new NO : UPDATE tag counts for navi after the next asset sync.
who: Vulnerability management leads whose priorities depend on criticality, and risk owners who know which assets actually matter.
better: Tag first, then calibrate: Linnaeus, Terminus and Sirius lay down the business tags Anubis calibrates against, and Covenant keeps them current and can apply ACR rules on its schedule. Fenrir (crown jewels = ACR ≥ 7) and Nemesis (crown jewels = ACR ≥ 9) both rank by the result.
different: the preview mirrors navi's own selection logic, so the count you approve is the count that changes.
every change carries Tenable's reason flags and is kept in the ACR log for audit.
NO : UPDATE stops a later bulk change from undoing a deliberate calibration; only Garmr removes it.
cta: Let Anubis weigh your estate — every priority downstream depends on the scales.
